issue_context.title: Collect telemetry on what causes the fallback bar
issue_context.body: To get a better idea of what is causing the fallback bar to show the most, we need to collect more detailed information on what is triggering it. We already somewhat do this with the [UNSUPPORTED_FEATURES](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/c218e94f664c97d3c95994d57b11d11488dae54b/src/shared/util.js#L290-L297) enum, but we need to audit each place that it is used and create more finer grained categories.
comments:
Upstream bug to add telemetry in Firefox:
https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1630844

review_comments:
Assuming that the `font` key is actually unused now, should it be removed?

The same question also applies for the `unknown` key above.
These are exposed on the API, so I'll just mark them as `@deprecated` for now,

> These are exposed on the API,

That's certainly true, but considering that nothing (in the PDF.js code) actually uses them now I just wondered what good they do for an API user at this point!? 

Anyway, it doesn't matter much either way here and the patch looks good as-is :-)
